name: Imouto ga Boku o Neratteru
source:
Keita has three imoutos: Erina, Tomoka and Yuzu. They may seem to be normal siblings, but he actually lusts after them, sneaking into their bedrooms at night and masturbating to their cute sleeping faces. At the same time, the oldest imouto Erina had fallen in love with him since he had always been by her side since she was born. However, she felt that there’s no way she could admit to having these feelings and continued to hide her true feelings. One day, a girl named Saori joined their family via their father’s remarriage, becoming their older sister. She was beautiful, kind, smart, great at housework and cooking – perfect in every way. Saori quickly became close with his imoutos and Erina found someone that she could confide in. Following Saori’s plan, his imoutos begin to launch a full-on assault on him.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/04/01/april-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
圭太有三个妹妹：绘里奈、朋花和柚子。她们看起来只是普通姐妹，可圭太其实对她们抱有淫欲，甚至会在夜里潜入她们的房间，对着熟睡时可爱的脸自慰。与此同时，大妹绘里奈从出生起就一直受到圭太陪伴，也早已爱上了他。可是，她觉得自己不可能承认这份感情，只能继续隐藏真心。

某天，父亲再婚，名叫沙织的女孩加入了这个家庭，成为圭太的姐姐。她美丽、温柔、聪明，家务和厨艺也无可挑剔，简直完美。沙织很快便与圭太的妹妹们亲近起来，绘里奈也找到了可以倾诉心事的人。在沙织的策划下，妹妹们开始向圭太发起全面攻势。

[引自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/04/01/april-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
